_what: The operating point for ONE held-out read of the cascade configuration. Written BEFORE the read, so that a number afterwards is a TEST and not a search.

configuration_FIXED.slate: top 30 of the PRE-RERANK CUE KEY (cue_only_order), survivors-first, as retrieve.rs draws it
configuration_FIXED.stage_1_narrow: ms-marco-MiniLM-L-2-v2-ft-session-j scores all 30, keep its top 10
configuration_FIXED.stage_2_fuse: fuse ms-marco-MiniLM-L-2-v2-ft-session-j and ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2-ft-session-j over the narrowed 10
configuration_FIXED.primary_fusion: RRF, k = 60 (Cormack et al. published default, fixed before any number existed)
configuration_FIXED.declared_secondary_fusion: per-query z-normalised score sum over the narrowed 10
configuration_FIXED._why_two: They tie on R@3 (0.9301) on fit and differ only at R@1 (0.7860 vs 0.7991 = 3 cases, plausibly noise). Both are computed from the SAME forward passes, so scoring both costs nothing. Declaring both here is what keeps this one test rather than a search; RRF is primary because it is parameter-free and scale-free, while z-sum assumes per-query normalisation over 10 points is stable.

the_knob_disclosed.argument_made_before_the_number: chosen to match the shipped slate width, so the final ranker sees the same number of candidates it does today
the_knob_disclosed.commitment: NOT swept before the read. Sensitivity to narrow width is a robustness check to be run AFTER the held-out read, never a selection before it.

fit_results_being_tested._all_gated: fit R@1 0.7555 reproduced exactly; depth-10 cue slate == the candidate set the binary actually reranked, 229/229; both graphs digest-pinned and smoke-tested; control cell reproduces rk-by-depth.json's depth-30 R@3 0.9258

REGISTERED_PREDICTION.held_out_R@3: 0.870 to 0.895, against a baseline of 0.8515. I expect roughly HALF the fit gain to survive, not none: the fit gain is not a fitted threshold and not a trained parameter -- it is a slate-width change plus a fusion of two graphs neither of which was selected on this metric. That is structurally unlike the four mechanisms that collapsed (depth +0.0174->+0.0044, arm B +0.0698->+0.0087, duoBERT +0.0655->+0.0044, context decay +0.0305->-0.0087), every one of which chose a threshold or mined negatives on fit.
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.held_out_input_recall: 0.965 to 0.980, against 0.9039 at depth 10. This is the component I am most confident in, because input recall is a property of the CUE ORDERING and the depth constant alone -- no model, no threshold, nothing fitted. If input recall does not rise to roughly this level, the reconstruction is wrong and every other number in the read is suspect.
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.what_would_falsify_the_whole_arm: held-out R@3 <= 0.8515 (no better than shipped), OR input recall failing to rise, which would mean the pipeline was not reconstructed correctly.
REGISTERED_PREDICTION.what_I_will_NOT_do_afterwards: sweep narrow width, sweep depth, try a third fusion, or read again. One read, this configuration, reported whatever it says.

reporting_requirements.significance: McNemar exact, paired, gained/lost counts -- not an unpaired delta. At n=229 the Wilson half-width at p=0.9 is about 0.039, so an unpaired read cannot resolve this effect.
reporting_requirements.denominators: report both the published 229 basis and the honest 234-answerable basis
reporting_requirements.stage_table: the full conditional stage-retention table -- each stage judged only where gold reached it

ship_decisions_kept_SEPARATE.1_ranking_change: slate depth + cascade + second graph. Both graphs are Tier A (BERT/WordPiece) and already digest-pinned, so this is a re-pin and not a new component. Delivers the R@1 gain, which helps the product exactly as it stands today.
ship_decisions_kept_SEPARATE.2_admission_change: inject top-3 instead of vec![order[0]]. This is what converts R@3 into product value and it is NOT part of this read. It carries costs the record already names -- tokens against 5.7, injection precision against K1's declared operating point, and stale-fact harm -- and needs its own pre-registration.

known_boundary.statement: R@3 = 0.9301 on fit sits about 3 cases below the label-oracle limit of this model family. Closing that needs a reranker trained for a different notion of relevance, not a configuration change.
